about: The Haftarah from the Prophets (1 Kings 2:1–12) is David’s last charge to Solomon: “Keep the charge of the LORD your God… as it is written in the Torah of Moses.” It parallels Jacob’s last words to his sons. The reading from the Apostles (Revelation 7:1–8) shows the twelve tribes Jacob blessed sealed by name as servants of God at the end of days, before the great multitude from every nation.
